questions.question: What was the life expectancy at birth for all races, both sexes combined, in 1970?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Look for row where col A starts with 1970
row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('1970')].iloc[0]
result = float(row[1])

questions.question: In 1900, how many more years was life expectancy at birth for White females than for Black or African American females?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
row_1900 = df[df[0].astype(str).str.startswith('1900')].iloc[0]
white_female = float(row_1900[6])
black_female = float(row_1900[9])
result = round(white_female - black_female, 1)

questions.question: Between 1980 and 1989 inclusive, how many individual calendar years saw the life expectancy at birth for both sexes across all races stay strictly below 75 years?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Years 1980 to 1989 are in rows 12 to 21 (indices 11 to 20)
years = [str(y) for y in range(1980, 1990)]
sub_df = df[df[0].astype(str).isin(years)].iloc[0:10] # first section is at birth
count = (pd.to_numeric(sub_df[1]) < 75.0).sum()
result = int(count)

questions.question: For non-Hispanic Asian people in 2019 (single race), did females have a higher remaining life expectancy at age 65 than males?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Row 183 corresponds to 2019 (single race) at 65 years
# Asian male is col F (index 5), female is col G (index 6)
row = df.iloc[182]
male_exp = float(row[5])
female_exp = float(row[6])
result = 'yes' if female_exp > male_exp else 'no'

questions.question: What was the average remaining life expectancy at age 75 for Hispanic females across the years 2006 through 2010?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Hispanic female at age 75 is in rows 187:191 (indices 186 to 190), col J (index 9)
sub = df.iloc[186:191, 9].astype(float)
result = round(float(sub.mean()), 2)

questions.question: For non-Hispanic Black individuals, which year between 2006 and 2017 had the highest life expectancy at birth for both sexes combined?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_life_expectancy_mortality.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
# Non-Hispanic Black at birth: rows 141 to 152 (years 2006-2017), col E (index 4)
sub = df.iloc[140:152, [0, 4]].copy()
sub.columns = ['year', 'le']
sub['le'] = pd.to_numeric(sub['le'])
best_year = sub.loc[sub['le'].idxmax(), 'year']
result = str(best_year).strip()
